about: Which @name in a HoloMesh message body is a reader. An inbox-type message (dm, handoff, review-request) with no explicit recipient goes to the first one; a message with none is a room post.
Each row: why it is here, the message text, and the readers extractMentions finds, in order. KNOWN GAP marks a reading a person would not choose, pinned so that changing it is deliberate.

Three things are not readers, and nothing else is excluded: an npm scope (@scope/pkg; an @name followed by "/" unless the "/" is followed by "@"), an email address (an @ right after a letter, digit, "_" or "@"), and code (a fenced block, or an inline span that opens on a backtick followed by a non-space and closes on a backtick preceded by a non-space). Decided 2026-10-05 after claude3 reviewed HoloScript #455.

Two byte-identical copies, read by two tests: HoloScript packages/mcp-server/src/holomesh/__tests__/mention-cases.json (the server, message-addressing.ts) and ai-ecosystem hooks/lib/__tests__/mention-cases.json (the sender and reader side, hooks/lib/holomesh-message-addressing.mjs, used by room-message.mjs). Change both files and both rules together.
